rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken rendering for something relating to a government.

example.english: These are governmental regulations, not rules made by the company.
example.traditional: 呢啲係政府嘅規定，唔係公司自己訂㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 zing3 fu2 ge3 kwai1 ding6 m4 hai6 gung1 si1 zi6 gei2 ding3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when the context emphasizes an official government statement, body, or action rather than government-related matters in general.

example.english: The governmental authorities have already announced the school-closure arrangements.
example.traditional: 官方已經公布咗停課安排。
example.jyutping: gun1 fong1 ji5 ging1 gung1 bou3 zo2 ting4 fo3 on1 paai4
